verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/planner.py:127 r'\?\s*$' counts any trailing '?' as a positive read cue, including a request to the agent ('Can/Could/Would you ...?'). With no listed edit verb the turn classifies as read with signals, so sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:1772 (read_only = inferred_intent == 'read' and bool(intent.signals)) strips every data write at :1788-1794.
verdicts.fix_shape: In classify_intent, do not count the bare trailing-'?' cue when the text is a request addressed to the agent (r'\b(can|could|would|will) you\b' or r'\bplease\b'). The turn then has no read signal and keeps the full tool set (D-B3-3: data writes still stage for review). Real read words still strip ('Can you explain...' keeps 'explain'; 'How is my portfolio doing?', 'Is RELIANCE up today?', 'what is P/E?' unchanged). This replaces a third round of verb-adding; a simulation keeps 11/11 failing phrasings and still strips all 5 controls.
verdicts.acceptance_test: sidecar/tests/test_b3_runtime_intent_gate.py: parametrized _agent_tool_ids test over 'Could you drop WIPRO from my portfolio?', 'Can you bump my INFY quantity to 30?', 'Would you scrap my ITC position?', 'Can you trim INFY to 5 shares?', 'Could you get rid of my HDFC Bank holding?' asserting the needed portfolio_delete_position/portfolio_update_position is in tool_ids; a strip test asserting 'Can you explain what a P/E ratio is?', 'Is RELIANCE up today?', 'How is my portfolio doing?' stay disjoint from _DATA_WRITES. Live: vy.py invoke copilot 'Would you scrap my ITC position?' --provider ollama --model llama3.1:8b --mode agent --autonomy auto --out x.jsonl must contain a tool_use named portfolio_delete_position.
verdicts.failure_sources: rc1 refutation-audit round 1 (partial); rc1 gate round 2 rc1-verifier:4 (partial, this audit)
verdicts.note: The entry's own repro holds at the candidate: every literal phrasing and the round-1 acceptance cases keep their write tools (55 tools); 192 tests pass. The verifier's 3 phrasings reproduce in-process (read, signal '?' only, 42 tools, no writes), and so do 8/8 auditor-fresh question-shaped delete/update asks. Live llama3.1:8b AUTO, 4/4 (2 verifier, 2 fresh): no tool_use, and the call is typed as JSON chat text (the entry's A1 symptom). The '?'-less twin 'Please drop WIPRO from my portfolio' emits a real portfolio_delete_position tool_use, which isolates the gate. This is the same partial as round 1: batch-12 only added log/record/qty-at-price cues, and its fresh cases were all add-shaped.

verdicts.root_cause: sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:937-947 (_normalise_tool_args) coerces only top-level properties (for key, value in args.items()) and never descends into items/nested properties. :946 type(parsed) in _JSON_STRING_TYPES[expected] also refuses an integral float ('5.0') for an integer param.
verdicts.fix_shape: Replace the top-level loop with a small recursive _coerce(value, schema) that applies the existing rule (exact JSON literal, parse_constant guard, type check) at every depth by descending into properties for objects and items for arrays, including after a stringified array/object is parsed. For integer, accept a parsed float with .is_integer() and store int(parsed). Validation afterwards is unchanged, and 'ten'/'NaN' stay invalid.
verdicts.acceptance_test: sidecar/tests/test_b3_runtime_tool_args.py: new test_nested_numeric_string_is_coerced. add_chart_drawing points [{'price':'185.5'}] -> points[0]['price']==185.5, no sentinel. yield_curve_value instruments[0] tenor '3', rate '0.05' -> 3 (int) and 0.05, no sentinel. Stringified points '[{"price": "185.5"}]' -> a list with 185.5. option_chain max_strikes '5.0' -> 5 with type int. Nested 'ten' -> sentinel, and test_a_non_numeric_integer_string_stays_invalid stays green. Live: cd sidecar && ./.venv/bin/python $SCRATCH/refaudit2-agent/agent093.py shows no __vysted_invalid_args__ on the VERIFIER REFUTATION rows.
verdicts.failure_sources: rc1 gate round 2 rc1-verifier:5 (partial, this audit); no batch not_certified; not in round 1
verdicts.note: The entry's repro holds: top-level '10'/'100'/'5' coerce to int and 'ten' stays invalid. The verifier's 3 cases reproduce exactly, and so does nested rate '0.05'. The catalog has 3 nested numeric params (add_chart_drawing.points[].price, yield_curve_value.instruments[].tenor/.rate), all inside the fix_shape's class, so this is partial. Severity is medium, not high: live llama3.1:8b sent nested numbers as numbers 0/4 times, and '5.0' was never observed. ADJACENT, register separately: in 3 of 4 live nested-tool calls, llama3.1:8b sent the array param as a Python-repr string ("[{'price': 185.5}]", once with 'tenor': 5*12). json.loads fails at agent_runtime.py:942-944, the gate rejects it as 'not of type array', and the turn ends with no data. Fix direction: an ast.literal_eval fallback for array/object params (literals only).
